name: kettlebell sumo deadlift
description: Deadlift from a wide stance with a kettlebell between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and back.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes angled out, the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
